EXECUTION FIXED: Corrected CloudFormation S3 BucketEncryption schema; simplified template to core resources only; enhanced error reporting; improved SLA timeouts. Executes Attack Step 1.2 (DescribeInstances reconnaissance), injects simulated UnauthorizedOperation event, validates incident response automation chain.
